title: Cut the design notes that are build logs and transcribed beads
description:
From the prose review of 2026-11-26. The unambiguous cuts are done in
fe887827; these need judgement about what is load-bearing, so they were
left.

## agent-frontends.md: 2,392 lines, should be about 600

Three documents in one file:

- Sections 1 and 2 are a snapshot of the pre-split code at commit
  e4e91cd, with about 60 line references into files the migration
  rewrote or deleted. Cut section 1 to a paragraph.
- Section 3 is a finished ten-step migration plan, 670 lines, each step
  carrying its own "Built (2026-11-20)" sub-log. A finished plan is a
  changelog. Cut to the end state; section 2 already describes it.
- Section 7 is 1,122 lines of 36 numbered decisions, each citing its own
  bead and listing its own test functions. AGENTS.md says "Plans live in
  the bead's design field" and "No planning, audit or scratch markdown
  files in the repo". This is that rule broken at scale, by us. Cut to a
  table of bead ids with one-line summaries, keeping in the body only
  the few items that changed the architecture.
- Section 4's prose is knowingly wrong and patched by forward
  references 800 lines later: the loopback claim, "No SASL", the 1:1
  room shape, attachments and playback are each reversed by section 7.
  A blanket disclaimer is not a fix; it is an instruction to distrust
  118 lines. Rewrite section 4 to describe what the IRC front end does,
  or cut it to the mapping table.

## purple-mimi.md: 1,765 lines, should be about 900

Sections 1 and 2 are 430 lines of libpurple survey and a five-option
comparison for a decision closed in section 3. Section 2.9 is 36 lines
of a rejected recommendation kept "as the record of what was weighed" --
left in place deliberately, since the author says it is kept on purpose,
but the bead is the record and the costs it names are stated three more
times. Two Decisions sections and two Uncertainties sections are
artefacts of the note being written in two sittings; merge each pair.

## frontend-auth.md: section 9's step plan

Steps 1-5, 9, 11 and 12 are built. An estimate in lines for finished
work is noise. Mark each row built or cut the table. (Its false "nothing
was built" header is already fixed.)

## air-api-comparison.md: the missing verdict

700 lines of comparison end with a complete sketch of a mimid gRPC
binding -- package, services, rpc table, what is worth copying -- and
never say whether to build it, who wants it, or what it would cost. The
file stops rather than concludes. Add a verdict at the head of section
6: proposed work, a bead, or a thought experiment kept for reference.
Also collapse A6 to A12, seven findings whose whole content is "no
change", into one table.

## The repeated ritual

All five big notes end in Open questions -> Recommendations ->
Decisions, where the Decisions section states the body was already
changed to match. Two of the five are cut (fe887827). The pattern is
worth not repeating: once a decision lands, the question and the
recommendation are dead weight.
